## What's the problem this PR addresses?

Closes #7300.

With `nodeLinker: node-modules` and workspace hoisting limits, several
physical copies of a package can share a locator but have different
virtual aliases. `buildLocatorMap` previously kept only the first copy's
aliases, so a direct dependency could be installed while `yarn workspace
webapp run <bin>` and `yarn workspace webapp bin <bin>` could not find
its executable.

## How did you fix it?

Copy the initial alias list and merge distinct aliases from subsequent
locations. This preserves the input tree and makes every installed
virtual alias available to the linker.

Added unit coverage for both location orders, duplicate aliases, and
input preservation, plus an acceptance fixture covering workspace binary
execution and lookup. Both unit cases and the acceptance case fail
against the original implementation. Release metadata covers
`@yarnpkg/nm` and its consumers.

## Validation

Native Windows. The unit and acceptance counts below use Node 24.15.0:

- nm unit tests: 35 passed.
- node-modules acceptance tests: 63 passed, 3 platform-specific skips.
- Full unit suite: 933 passed, 12 skipped, 217 snapshots passed. Six
failures in shell input-redirection and ZipOpenFS symlink tests also
occur on an untouched checkout of the base commit (931 passed, the same
six failures).
- Full TypeScript check (Node 22.14.0), ESLint on changed TypeScript
files, constraints, version check, and diff check passed. ESLint used
native Node 22.14.0 because the existing PnP loader fails during startup
on Node 24 here. Source CLI commands used
`--no-experimental-require-module` for that existing compatibility
issue.

The full unit suite was also compared on Node 22.14.0: 931 passed with
this change versus 929 on the original, with the same eight failures and
12 skips in both runs.

CI follow-up: Testing chores (including full lint, type checks,
constraints and release checks) passed. The three Windows Node 27
nightly shards fail before tests with
`ERR_OSSL_ENTROPY_SOURCE_STRENGTH_TOO_WEAK`. The identical nightly and
error also fail in the [pre-existing October 12
run](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/actions/runs/38296282434/job/114968565572).
See the [current shard
log](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/actions/runs/38511685998/job/115681745644).
Other test jobs are still running.
